name: Amberdrop · Gremlet #50
description:
A drop of ancient tree resin with a tiny leaf inside. It remembers forests nobody else does.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Amberdrop in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
